name: Dungeons and Dames
source: A stranger pays you a hefty sum of money to teach a woman how to play a role-playing game. Will you be able to seduce her in the middle of the game? Will you prove that tabletop role-playing games hold no secrets for you?
translation: 一个陌生人花重金雇你教一位女士怎么玩角色扮演游戏。你能否在跑团途中成功俘获她的芳心？又能否证明桌面角色扮演游戏对你而言早已没有任何秘密可言？
